description: Search Ptitchef recipes, read one, and rescale it to any servings. No API key.
name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-ptitchef

environmentVariables.description: Identify your own client. This project's identifier stays appended, so the site can always reach a human.
environmentVariables.name: PTC_USER_AGENT

environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 1500, floor 1000, ceiling 60000.
environmentVariables.name: PTC_MIN_INTERVAL_MS

environmentVariables.description: Deadline for one request, in milliseconds. Default 20000.
environmentVariables.name: PTC_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Retries when the site is busy or asks for room. Default 3.
environmentVariables.name: PTC_MAX_RETRIES

environmentVariables.description: In-memory cache lifetime, in milliseconds. Default 900000. Set 0 to turn it off.
environmentVariables.name: PTC_CACHE_TTL_MS

environmentVariables.description: The most one page may run to before the read is abandoned. Default 8000000.
environmentVariables.name: PTC_MAX_BODY_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: The whole of the time one read may take, retries included. Default 60000.
environmentVariables.name: PTC_BUDGET_MS

environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error. Logs go to stderr.
environmentVariables.name: PTC_LOG_LEVEL
